The paper uses as-cast alloys tested at room temperature in compression, nanoindentation creep, and 3.5 wt% NaCl corrosion. rationale.outcome_agreement: The hypothesis predicts higher yield strength, creep resistance, retained/improved ductility, and enhanced corrosion resistance. The paper predicts and finds increased strength and creep resistance at moderate Zr (x=0.05) but notes that excess Zr (x=0.1) reduces mechanical properties, and corrosion resistance is best at x=0.1. The hypothesis does not capture the non-monotonic mechanical behavior or the trade-off between mechanical and corrosion performance seen in the paper.
